entry.description: `InterProcessLock` and `MinimalLock` write out their buffered text before releasing the lock, so processes sharing a file no longer overwrite or split each other's records: `ImmediateFlush=false` has no effect with them and is reported once per activation. A long header, a layout throwing halfway and the footer no longer leave text behind; the footer is written and the file closed within a single lock (ANT-2026-EAZMFSKC, fixed by @FreeAndNil)
